## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes (the GUI tests too, if what is drawn has changed)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` are clean
- [ ] A new tool or a fixed bug has a test
- [ ] README.md or docs/ are updated for what the user sees
- [ ] Models from earlier versions still open (names in model files are unchanged)
